description: Find restaurants, cafes, dhabas, bakeries, bars, sweet shops and delivery kitchens anywhere in India by words and place. Each result has id, name, url, kind, cuisines, address, phone, open_now (IST), timings, cost for two, rating, photo and distance for near-me searches.

city.description: City slug, e.g. bengaluru, mumbai, delhi, hyderabad, chennai, pune, kolkata

cuisine.description: Cuisine slug: north-indian, south-indian, biryani, chinese, pizza, cafe, desserts, street-food, ...

locality.description: Area slug within the city, e.g. indiranagar, koramangala, bandra-west

open_now.description: true = only places whose listed timings say open now (IST)

q.description: Name, dish or cuisine words. "biryani in kondapur" also works.

name: search_restaurants
title: Search restaurants in India
